name: Ginger Beef, Bell Pepper & Cabbage Stir-Fry with Cauliflower Rice

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, ginger, and riced cauliflower. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is tender, 6-7 minutes. Transfer cauliflower rice to a large plate and cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pot for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 (340 g) bags frozen, riced cauliflower

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; small dice.
Return pot to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper and beef; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1.02 kg lean ground beef

instructions.primary_message: When the beef is done, add shredded cabbage and stir-fry sauce to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the cabbage has softened, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (397 g) bags shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)
1 cup stir-fry sauce

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide cauliflower rice between plates or bowls. Top with beef stir-fry and enjoy!
